title: UL-14 — Challenge: RDS single-AZ
scenario: Restore RDS to a new instance from snapshot, validate, delete copy then source.
acceptanceCriteria: Source RDS instance created single-AZ smallest class.
Restored copy instance identifier distinct from source.
Connectivity or describe validated on copy.
Source instance deleted without final snapshot if policy allows.
Subnet group and SG cleaned up.

hints.text: Delete copy first to save cost.

stopChargesPanel: Delete the restored copy, then the source RDS instance (wait for each), then the manual snapshot, the DB subnet group and the lab SG for ul-14. Forgotten 24 h ≈ $1.12 (a floor; see the cost basis).

orderedDeletesPowerShell: # Uses: $CopyDbId, $DbId, $DbSnapshotId, $SubnetGroup, $SgId (the IDs you set while building; unset ones are skipped)
# Lost an ID? aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-14
if ($CopyDbId) { aws rds delete-db-instance --db-instance-identifier $CopyDbId --skip-final-snapshot; aws rds wait db-instance-deleted --db-instance-identifier $CopyDbId }
if ($DbId) { aws rds delete-db-instance --db-instance-identifier $DbId --skip-final-snapshot; aws rds wait db-instance-deleted --db-instance-identifier $DbId }
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-14 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
aws rds describe-db-instances --db-instance-identifier $DbId returns DBInstanceNotFound (repeat with $CopyDbId)
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-14 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-14. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

beforeYouStart: Read the paired guided lab (gl-14) stop-charges panel before you create anything.
Set $env:AWS_PROFILE and $env:AWS_REGION. Do not use the root user.

Cost basis (us-east-1, priced 2026-09-29): 2 RDS db.t3.micro Single-AZ (source + restored copy) $0.018/h each, billed in full hours, and 60 GB of storage* (two 20 GB instances + one 20 GB manual snapshot) at $0.125/GB-month; no public IPv4; * io1 storage rate $0.125/GB-month from the RDS PostgreSQL page (US East (N. Virginia) example), used as a conservative upper bound because the gp2/gp3 storage rate could not be read: rate not verified on 2026-09-29; re-check the pricing page before running; same-hour ≈ $0.10, forgotten 24 h ≈ $1.12. This is a floor: it excludes data transfer and LCU/usage charges. Re-read the pricing page before you run the lab.
